note: Named coding changes, possibly across several modules. Each step names the module, BMW's function name and the value label to set. The recipe tool resolves names against the module's own CAFD at run time, batches all steps of one module into one signed write, and refuses a step whose name or value the CAFD does not have.

remote-engine-start.title: EXPERIMENTAL remote engine start from the key (for A/C before getting in)
remote-engine-start.risk: high (CAS immobiliser + FZD) and very unlikely to work
remote-engine-start.test: Only with the car locked, in P, nobody inside, outdoors. Try the BMW remote-start gesture (lock, then hold the 3rd button for ZEIT_REMOTE_KEY_3RD_BUTTON). Watch for Check Control messages; revert from the backup if anything looks wrong.
remote-engine-start.status: Research 2026-11-22: no report of these CAS4 switches working on any F-series. Forum consensus: the key never sends the start request and CAS4 will not start without a key inside. BMW's factory remote start (SA 1CR) is G-series, petrol only, and needs a DME FSC. Kept only as a reversible experiment; see bmw/PLAN-remote-climate.md.
